keyWhy.ko: 핵심은 «전염병이 여러 나라에 널리 퍼지면 팬데믹이라고 부른다(주제)» 와 «병이 퍼지는 방식을 이해하면 나와 다른 사람을 함께 지키는 현명한 선택을 할 수 있다(결론)» 입니다. 초록색 문장이 정답이에요.
keyWhy.en: The key ideas are the topic (when an infectious disease spreads widely across many countries, it is called a pandemic) and the conclusion (understanding how diseases spread helps people make wise choices that protect themselves and others). The green sentences are the answers.

qs.q: Why can diseases travel around the world so quickly today?
qs.qko: 오늘날 병은 왜 그렇게 빨리 전 세계로 퍼질 수 있나요?
opts: Because germs can live forever on paper money
Because airplanes can carry an infected person across the world in less than a day
evs: Some germs spread through tiny drops in the air when people cough, sneeze, or talk.
Airplanes can carry an infected person across the world in less than a day, and crowded cities allow diseases to spread quickly.
Vaccines train the immune system to recognize germs before a person becomes sick.
His map helped show that the disease spread through dirty water.
why: 비행기는 감염된 사람을 하루도 안 되어 지구 반대편까지 데려갈 수 있어요. 그래서 병이 빠르게 여러 나라로 퍼져요.
Airplanes can carry an infected person across the world in less than a day, so diseases spread to many countries quickly.

qs.q: In the text, what does 'R, the reproduction number' mean?
qs.qko: 글에서 'R, the reproduction number(감염 재생산 수)' 는 무슨 뜻인가요?
opts: The number of countries a disease reaches
The number of days a person stays sick
The average number of people one sick person infects
evs: R is the average number of people that one sick person infects.
A disease that starts in one small town can sometimes reach every continent within a few months.
Scientists also track cases around the world so that health workers can respond early.
In addition, many new diseases begin in animals and then jump to humans.
why: 바로 다음 문장에서 R은 아픈 사람 한 명이 평균적으로 감염시키는 사람 수라고 설명해요.
The next sentence explains that R is the average number of people one sick person infects.

qs.q: Why can washing hands and staying home when ill help end an outbreak?
qs.qko: 손 씻기와 아플 때 집에 머무르기는 왜 유행을 끝내는 데 도움이 되나요?
opts: They lower R, and an outbreak shrinks when R is below one
They raise R, and an outbreak ends when R is above one
They make germs travel faster on airplanes
evs: Simple actions, such as washing hands and staying home when ill, can lower the value of R.
Pandemics are caused by germs such as viruses and bacteria that pass from person to person.
If R is above one, the number of cases grows; if it is below one, the outbreak slowly shrinks.
History shows that pandemics, such as the 1918 flu and COVID-19, can cause enormous harm.
why: 간단한 행동은 R 값을 낮추고, R이 1보다 작아지면 유행이 서서히 줄어들어요. 두 문장을 연결해야 해요.
Simple actions lower R, and when R is below one, the outbreak slowly shrinks. Connect the two sentences.

ends: How did one map change the way we fight disease?
지도 한 장이 어떻게 질병과 싸우는 방법을 바꾸었을까?

새로운 병은 어떻게 동물에서 사람으로 옮겨 올까?
